_note: Entirely invented patients. No real person, no real patient record. Dates are stored as offsets from the day the database is seeded, so the demo stays realistic whenever it is run. days_ago counts backwards from today, in_days counts forwards. The seeder moves any appointment that lands on a weekend, a lunch hour, or a day the named clinician does not work forward to the next time that clinician is actually available.
